rules: Each case always includes every schema required by seed.expectedActions.
Remaining slots filled by deterministic shuffle seeded with 'active10:' + case.id.
Active list stored in case JSON in catalog order (not shuffle order) for stable diffs.
Do NOT resample at eval runtime — scores must be reproducible.
Do NOT use empty activeSchemas (invalid) or full-catalog-only (too easy / less routing stress).
